features: 📶 Bluetooth 5.0 Wireless Audio: Built-in Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity allows compatible smartphones, tablets and other Bluetooth-enabled devices to stream audio wirelessly to the amplifier module.
⚡ Low-Voltage 3.7V–5V DC Operation: Designed to operate from approximately 3.7V to 5V DC, making it suitable for battery-powered and USB-powered audio projects.
🔊 Stereo Audio Output: Supports dual-channel stereo amplification for left and right speakers, making it suitable for compact wireless speaker and DIY sound-system applications.
🔋 Suitable for Rechargeable Projects: The low operating-voltage range allows integration with compatible 3.7V lithium battery systems and regulated 5V power supplies.
🎵 Compact Wireless Amplifier Design: Combines Bluetooth audio reception and stereo amplification on one compact PCB, reducing the need for separate wireless receiver and amplifier boards.
🔧 Easy DIY Integration: Simple power, speaker and audio circuitry makes the module convenient for use in custom speakers, portable sound boxes and embedded electronics projects.
🚗 Suitable for Custom Car Audio Projects: Can be used in compatible low-voltage auxiliary car-audio and speaker projects when powered through an appropriately regulated supply.
🌡️ Efficient Digital Amplification: Designed for efficient audio amplification with reduced power loss and heat generation, making it suitable for compact enclosures and portable applications.
🛠️ Wide Application Range: Suitable for wireless speakers, desktop audio systems, portable sound projects, electronics prototyping, embedded audio equipment and DIY music systems.
🖤 Compact Black PCB Module: Features a black circuit-board design with a small footprint, allowing easy installation inside custom speaker enclosures and space-constrained electronic projects.
